description: Measure approximate camera-to-visible-surface distance in a tight ROI on the latest metric-depth observation. Coordinates are normalized against the complete attached display_size; the box must stay within scene_bounds and exclude the appended color bar. Width and height must each be no more than 0.20. Select one coherent representative interior surface and avoid edges, ground, and background. Inconsistent-depth boxes are rejected for recentering. Use for explicit meter values and thresholds; remeasure after physical motion.

observation_id.description: Exact observation_id shown on the CURRENT image label.

x_min.description: Left displayed-image pixel divided by display_width.

y_min.description: Top displayed-image pixel divided by display_height; it must remain above the color bar.

y_max.description: Bottom displayed-image pixel divided by display_height; it must remain above the color bar and y_max-y_min must be <= 0.20.
